reason: A DSH UI plugin that recalculates and displays the local cache hit rate with two decimal places while preserving the rest of the statistics line.

summaries.zh: 该插件重新计算并以两位小数显示 DSH 状态栏中的缓存命中率，同时保留其他统计信息。
summaries.en: This plugin recalculates and displays the DSH status bar cache hit rate to two decimal places while preserving the other statistics.

capabilities: Replaces the displayed DSH statistics line component
Reads local token usage statistics to calculate cache hit percentage
Formats the cache hit rate to two decimal places
